title: Service Fees and the Inactivity Fee, Paystride Visa Payroll Card Account
content:
**Rule.** Service fees on the Paystride Visa Payroll Card Account follow the plan held on the day they are incurred. A service order incurs at most one fee of each fee type.

**Replacement and reissue.** A replacement ordered for a lost, stolen or damaged card costs the plan's replacement card fee. It is free when the account's earlier replacement orders for a lost, stolen or damaged card in the 365 calendar days ending on the order date are fewer than the plan's free replacements per 12 months. A reissue of a card nearing expiry is free when the plan makes expiry reissue free. Expedited shipping costs the plan's expedited shipping fee in addition, and the free allowance never covers it. Both fees point to the service order.

**Card-to-bank transfers.** A card-to-bank transfer costs the plan's card-to-bank transfer fee, unless its position in its pay period is within the plan's free card-to-bank transfers per pay period. Its position is counted among the card-to-bank transfers posted in its pay period, in posting order, the transfer itself included.

**Inactivity.**
- The account is inactive when its last activity date is the plan's inactivity period or more calendar days before today. The last activity date is the latest posted date among loads of any source and debits the cardholder initiated: purchases, ATM withdrawals, teller cash withdrawals, card-to-bank transfers and transfers to the cardholder's Paystride Save account. Access recovery debits, employer load reversals and fees are not activity.
- An inactivity fee is assessed only once the inactivity period in calendar days has passed since the account's last activity date. Calendar days are counted from the day after the last activity date. The first inactivity fee therefore posts on the last activity date plus the inactivity period. Later ones post on the same day of each following calendar month, or on that month's last day when it has no such day.
- An account incurs at most one inactivity fee on a posted date.
- The inactivity fee is the plan's inactivity fee and carries the fee type inactivity. It is reduced to the balance when the balance is smaller, is not assessed on a zero balance, and stops as soon as any load posts or the cardholder initiates any debit.

**Listed fees.** The monthly account fee, the written history fee and the closing-balance check fee are charged as listed. Where zero, they are never assessed. A fee that comes to zero is not assessed, and no fee takes the balance below zero.

## Hypothetical inactivity calendar (90-day period, last activity on 31 October)

| | Date |
|---|---|
| the day before the first fee date | 28 January |
| first inactivity fee | 29 January (31 October plus 90 days, in a year whose February has 28 days) |
| next fee | 28 February (no 29 February that year, so the month's last day) |
| following fee | 29 March |

A load or a cardholder-initiated debit posting on 10 February stops the fees from that day.

## Hypothetical replacement case

On a plan with 1 free replacement per 12 months, an account with no earlier lost, stolen or damaged replacement order in the 365 days ending on the order date pays no replacement fee. With one such earlier order, it pays the plan's replacement card fee.
